notes: Direct immutable CREATE2 deployment; mine the hook address so its low 14 bits equal 0x20c4. Constructor arguments resolve to Ethereum mainnet PoolManager 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90 and the freshly deployed SWARMLER token. Static 1.25% LP fee plus 1% of the actual unspecified-currency BalanceDelta, rounded down, collected as ERC-6909 claims. Anyone may sweep token claims to 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD or execute IMD-funded batch buybacks in a separate unlock. Batches spend up to 25%, use a 300 bps directional sqrt-price bound, halve the budget after more than 50 blocks without a fresh reference, and start the 3600 second cooldown only upon spending at least 1% of the budget. Buybacks pay no hook fee. The factory receives the full 1e27 supply and handles all distribution and opening-price economics; initialPrice is provenance only.
